info.title: Chi's New Address
info.synopsis: La famiglia Yamada vive in un condominio che vieta di tenere animali in casa, ma nonostante questo divieto, già da tempo ha segretamente adottato una gattina trovata nel parco. Con il passare dei mesi, la piccola Chi è diventata sempre più curiosa e desiderosa di esplorare l'ambiente esterno e, per questo motivo, più volte gli Yamada hanno corso il rischio di venire scoperti.

episodes.title: Chii Seeks.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamada family talks about whether they should send Chi to Juri in Hokkaido or not.

episodes.title: Chii Brings Someone Along.
episodes.synopsis: Dad dreams that Chi is taken away to Hokkaido by Juri.

episodes.title: Chii Runs Away From Home.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei overhears Mom and Dad talking about sending Chi away and runs away with her. Chi runs from Youhei when he is talking with his parents in the park and chases a bird.

episodes.title: Chii Decides Again.
episodes.synopsis: Chi comes back to the family, and they decide that instead of sending her away, they will move to a house where pets are allowed.

episodes.title: Chii Prepares.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is isolated in the bathroom while the movers take the boxes and imagines all the bad things the noises would be.

episodes.title: Chii Imagines.
episodes.synopsis: Chi comes out of the bathroom and goes to new home with the Yamada family.

episodes.title: Chii Reminisces.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamada family takes Chi to the new home, but Chi does not want to come out of the box, thinking it is the animal hospital.

episodes.title: Chii Reminisces.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamada family takes Chi to the new home, but Chi does not want to come out of the box, thinking it is the animal hospital.

episodes.title: Chii Sniffs Around.
episodes.synopsis: While Chi is in the new home, she picks up strange smells around the house. She wants to return to the old house.

episodes.title: Chii Breaks the House in.
episodes.synopsis: Chi makes everything in her new home smell like her.

episodes.title: Chii Has an Idea.
episodes.synopsis: Chi figures out how to use the kitty-door.

episodes.title: Chii Greets. (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas visit their new neighbors, Akashi who owns a parakeet, Lucky, and Furukawa who owns a rabbit, Mi-chan.

episodes.title: Chii Greets. (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas continue to meet their new neighbors, including a woman named Ijyuin with a golden long-haired cat named Alice.

episodes.title: Chii Challenges.
episodes.synopsis: Chi and the Yamadas meet their next-door neighbor, Kusano Yuki with a dog, David.

episodes.title: Chii Goes Into the Garden.
episodes.synopsis: Chi finally goes outside to her new backyard.

episodes.title: Chii Retaliates.
episodes.synopsis: Chi isn't happy with the dog David from next door, but discovers that David can't come in her backyard.

episodes.title: Chii Welcomes.
episodes.synopsis: Chi's neighbor Alice comes into her home.

episodes.title: Chii Plays.
episodes.synopsis: Chi chases a butterfly and goes into the Kusano's yard.

episodes.title: Chii Goes Outside.
episodes.synopsis: Chi discovers the outside of her yard.

episodes.title: Chii Is Excited.
episodes.synopsis: Chi follows other cats and wanders away from home.

episodes.title: Chii Returns.
episodes.synopsis: Chi goes back to her old home but notices something and wonders where her home is.

episodes.title: Chii Is Invited.
episodes.synopsis: Chi meets an orange, black and white cat named Mike and is invited to his house. He asks Chi if she wants to stay at his place instead.

episodes.title: Chii Leaves Footprints.
episodes.synopsis: Chi comes back from outside and leaves pawprints everywhere at home.

episodes.title: Chii Is Stopped.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is stopped by the Yamadas from touching many things.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Mad.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei invites his friends Mayu and Ryu, and introduces Chi. However, Ryu is scared of cats.

episodes.title: Chii Makes Up.
episodes.synopsis: Chi gets angered by Ryu, and Youhei's friends tries to make up for Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Adored.
episodes.synopsis: Chi meets the pet store lady and she falls in love with Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Chased.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is followed by the pet store lady and loses her. Mr. Yamada brags about Chi to the pet store lady.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Carried.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is carried in a kitty bag and Mr. Yamada comes to the pet store again to bet who is the cutest cat.

episodes.title: Chii Runs Around.
episodes.synopsis: Chi meets the pet store lady again and escapes from her.

episodes.title: Chii Is Kept Waiting.
episodes.synopsis: Chi visits the Furukawas, sees Mi-chan the rabbit, and waits.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Mimicked.
episodes.synopsis: Chi visits the Akashi thinking that Lucky is food but Lucky impersonates Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Cuts Through.
episodes.synopsis: Chi likes to go through things.

episodes.title: Chii Can`t Sleep.
episodes.synopsis: Chi tries to sleep, and then plays.

episodes.title: Chii Makes Sure.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei gets his birthday present and Chi likes it.

episodes.title: Chii Tastes Food.
episodes.synopsis: Ms. Yamada gets Youhei's Birthday party ready and hopes Chi doesn't ruin it.

episodes.title: Chii Causes Chaos.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei's Birthday party begins and Chi is frightened of Youhei's present.

episodes.title: Chii Celebrates.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei's Birthday party ends and Mr. Yamada has the new pictures developed. The Yamadas realize that it's the first birthday that Chi has ever been to.

episodes.title: Chii Walks Around.
episodes.synopsis: Chi goes out of her yard again and chases a butterfly. Chi wanders off again, this time to an arcade street.

episodes.title: Chii Hears A Story.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is rescued by a cat with a ribbon around its neck named Tama, and Tama keeps telling Chi to be careful.

episodes.title: Chii Makes Her Debut.
episodes.synopsis: Chi follows Tama to a cat meeting for the first time to meet other cats, including the elder cat Fuji-San.

episodes.title: Chii Looks To The Sky.
episodes.synopsis: The cat meeting begins, and Fuji-San just says comforting things to the cats.

episodes.title: Chii Is Warmly Welcomed.
episodes.synopsis: Chi visits Ijyuin's place to see Alice.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Washed.
episodes.synopsis: Mrs. Yamada takes Chi to a pet salon for the first time with Ijyuin and Alice.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Opened.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamada tries to open Chi's mouth to brush her teeth.

episodes.title: Chii Brushes Her Teeth.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamada buys stuff from the pet store and again tries to brush Chi's teeth.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Tested.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas want to go on a trip but are afraid that Chi can't come, so Mr. Yamada and Youhei take Chi to ride a bus first.

episodes.title: Chii Rides.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas want to go on a trip with Chi and so they decide to get a car.

episodes.title: Chii Drives.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas drive their new car around the neighborhood with Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Goes Home.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamada is getting used to driving, and they go to a drive-through to get lunch. Then Chi gets out through the window.

episodes.title: Chii Rolls.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas decide to go play tennis while Chi plays with tennis balls.

episodes.title: Chii Runs About.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada plays tennis with each other and Chi wants to play with the tennis ball.

episodes.title: Chii Dives.
episodes.synopsis: Chi goes to Fuji-San's house.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Admired.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is carried to the cat meeting by Fuji-San and then David scares the other cats.

episodes.title: Chii Trims The Bamboo Tree.
episodes.synopsis: The Tanabata (Bamboo) Festival comes and the Yamadas get a bamboo tree to decorate , but Chi comes back home.

episodes.title: Chii Wishes Upon a Star.
episodes.synopsis: Since the bamboo tree is ruined, the Yamadas use a Christmas tree instead, and Youhei makes a wish.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Drenched.
episodes.synopsis: Chi goes out, and then it rains.

episodes.title: Chii Is Sucked Up.
episodes.synopsis: Mrs. Yamada tries to vacuum the house, but Chi doesn't want to move.

episodes.title: Chii Is In Sync.
episodes.synopsis: Chi and Youhei are in sync together.

episodes.title: Chii Overcomes.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei and Chi are home alone.

episodes.title: Chii Is Treated.
episodes.synopsis: Tama and Alice argue about whose food is better, and Chi acts as the judge.

episodes.title: Chii Is Followed.
episodes.synopsis: Tama and Alice keep and eye on Chi. As the argue, she wanders off.

episodes.title: Chii Is Discovered.
episodes.synopsis: Chi wanders away and learns how to climb a tree, but can't get down.

episodes.title: Chii Goes Down.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is stuck in a tree and Ryu rescues Chi to overcome his fear.

episodes.title: Chii Scoops.
episodes.synopsis: Summer has come and the Yamadas plan to have nagashi-soumen, which is noodles eaten straight from water flowing through little bamboo canals.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Taken Away.
episodes.synopsis: The Summer Festival has come and it is Chi's first time with Tama.

episodes.title: Chii Experiences.
episodes.synopsis: Chi gets to experience the Summer Festival with Tama.

episodes.title: Chii Looks Up.
episodes.synopsis: Chi and Tama have a good time at the Summer Festival. Chi is found by the Yamadas and looks surprised at the fireworks.

episodes.title: Chii Becomes Popular.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada compete as to who understands Chi the best.

episodes.title: Chii Leaps.
episodes.synopsis: Ms. Yamada buys Youhei a balloon.

episodes.title: Chii Boasts.
episodes.synopsis: Chi follows the dog David, and shows off that she can go anywhere.

episodes.title: Chii Falls.
episodes.synopsis: Chi gets trapped in a garbage can and can't get out.

episodes.title: Chii Crosses the Sea.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi are going to Hokkaido to visit Juri and her family. They take Chi along for the cruise but Chi has to stay in a cage.

episodes.title: Chii Travels Around in Hokkaido.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi arrive in Hokkaido and are headed to Juri and her family's ranch.

episodes.title: Chii Rides a Horse.
episodes.synopsis: Juri shows Youhei and Chi the horses. Youhei rides together with Juri on a pony while Chi on the other hand has a different ride.

episodes.title: Chii Scares People.
episodes.synopsis: It's bedtime for Youhei and Juri, but Youhei gets scared when Juri says that there are monsters.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Surrounded.
episodes.synopsis: It's early morning, and the morning crowing from the rooster wakes Chi up. Chi finds herself some prey, and trouble.

episodes.title: Chii Meets a Cow.
episodes.synopsis: Juri shows Youhei and Chi the barn where they milk cows.

episodes.title: Chii Looks at the Stars.
episodes.synopsis: It is the last day that the Yamadas and Chi are staying. Juri decides to show Youhei and Chi her treasure.

episodes.title: Chii Meets a Red Fox.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi finally leave the ranch, but then stop at a sunflower field and decide to take a picture. But then Chi follows a butterfly and meets a Northern Fox.

episodes.title: Chii Chaperones.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamada has to work and can't play with Chi; But Chi always cause trouble and can't stay still.

episodes.title: Chii Plays in the Garden.
episodes.synopsis: Kusano Yuki comes over to the Yamadas to play with David. Chi tries to play with David in the yard.

episodes.title: Chii Is Shown Gratitude.
episodes.synopsis: The pet store lady comes to visit Chi and brings her some pet clothes. When Chi runs away from the pet store lady's dress-up session, Chi finds Youhei with Mrs. Yamada, playing with Mayu and Ryu. When the pet store lady finds her, there's a surprise.

episodes.title: Chii Goes Together.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is going to the cat meeting and Alice comes along and tries to fit in.

episodes.title: Chii Is Involved.
episodes.synopsis: Chi's favorite toy is worn out and Ms. Yamada tries to make a homemade toy for Chi to play with.

episodes.title: Chii Has a Conversation.
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamada is late for an important meeting, but in his haste, unknowingly takes Chi along.

episodes.title: Chii Performs Music.
episodes.synopsis: Youhei practices the piano for school and Chi wants to play too.

episodes.title: Chii Plants Seeds.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas decided to plant some flowers and Chi wants to play in their newly made garden.

episodes.title: Chii Is Mistaken.
episodes.synopsis: Chi remembers her first friend, the big black cat.

episodes.title: Chii Is in a Hurry.
episodes.synopsis: Chi mistakenly gets into a pickup truck and goes out of town. Chi is lost and can't get home.

episodes.title: Chii Gets Surrounded.
episodes.synopsis: Chi couldn't find her way home but finds some company led by Tiger.

episodes.title: Chii Stays.
episodes.synopsis: Chi sleeps at Tiger and his friend's place but wants to go home.

episodes.title: Chii Conveys a Message.
episodes.synopsis: Chi is on her way home until she meets Tama's little sister, Hana.

episodes.title: Chii Advances.
episodes.synopsis: Chi tries following the sun to find home, but encounters many obstacles. Everyone including the Yamadas continue looking for Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Collapses.
episodes.synopsis: Chi still can't find her way home and collapsed with exhaustion. The Yamadas have not yet given up searching for Chi.

episodes.title: Chii Meets Again.
episodes.synopsis: Chi meets the big black cat again.

episodes.title: Chii Is Happy.
episodes.synopsis: Chi travels with the big black cat.

episodes.title: Chii Renews her Promise.
episodes.synopsis: Chi finds her way home and made a promise with the big black cat.

episodes.title: Chii Runs.
episodes.synopsis: The Yamadas go to the place where they first found Chi, and find Chi again.

episodes.title: Chii Makes a Family.
episodes.synopsis: Chi finally returns home and so everyone holds a party for her. Everyone there is her family.
